responsibilities_block: Inspect wind-turbine units.
Diagnose electrical faults.
Replace worn components.
Perform preventive maintenance.
Record vibration data.
Conduct emergency repairs after shutdowns.
page.work_context_block: At dawn, review wind speeds and plan the day, then climb towers to inspect gearboxes and blades. At midday, measure electrical parameters, replace sensors, and send vibration data to the operations center. In the afternoon, perform preventive maintenance based on alerts, tighten bolts, and lubricate parts. When winds increase, stop work, organize the day's work orders and spare parts, and prepare the next day's turbines.
